items.title: Man City are 'messier', but are they more dangerous than ever?
items.excerpt: Trying to find a chink in Manchester City's armour is like looking for a needle in a haystack. If it does exist, it's barely detectable. Andree Jeglertz's impact has been profound in that sense.
body: Trying to find a chink in Manchester City's armour is like looking for a needle in a haystack. If it does exist, it's barely detectable. Andree Jeglertz's impact has been profound in that sense.

City did not need to revolutionise the way they worked to reach this point, only the way they thought. Before Jeglertz, title talk was taboo. Under him it's mandated to such an extent it's written on the walls of their training base.

Because how does one learn the habits of a champion if the subject is not part of the everyday playbook? The Swede never considered the Women's Super League title aspirational, even in year one. How can it be at a club like Manchester City? All the tools are there.

Except of course winning silverware is not always the reserve of the club's with the best resources and most versatile talent. Nor should it be. That is what keeps football exciting. And, crucially here, what drives City's group to want to reinvent ways football matches can be won no matter the circumstance. WSL scores & fixtures | FREE WSL highlights Got Sky? items.title: In a clash of the top two, should Chelsea be considered underdogs?
items.excerpt: To consider Chelsea as underdogs in domestic competition feels alien. To a club so endowed with silverware and success over such a long period, it's like a dirty word. Something reserved for opponents, not them.
body: To consider Chelsea as underdogs in domestic competition feels alien. To a club so endowed with silverware and success over such a long period, it's like a dirty word. Something reserved for opponents, not them.

But reality bites hard. The Blues lost their title to league and cup double winners Manchester City last term, in a season where they also suffered their second heaviest WSL defeat ever to the eventual champions.

That statement 5-1 drubbing back in February was the most obvious illustration of the gap that had appeared between superpowers. City were everything Chelsea used to be; a team relentlessly driven by title-winning standards. Every decision deliberately constructed to give them control and assert dominance.

This is the first WSL season to feature two unbeaten teams after nine matchdays since 2020-21.
